title: Calculate settlement totals per merchant
sqlValidation:
SELECT merchantId, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS merchantSettlementTotal
FROM dbo.Settlements
GROUP BY merchantId
ORDER BY merchantId;
sqlExpectedResult: Each total matches the expected settlement total for that merchant.
